text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia got injured during training, so 
I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you're making such a fuss, 
Trainer. It's just a little pain.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it really was just a minor 
injury!
choice_data_list: Because stopping you there is my job.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I'm totally fine, though. Being a 
Trainer sure sounds tough.
choice_data_list: そこで止めるのが仕事だから
choice_data_list_en: Because stopping you there is my job.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever! I know what condition I'm 
in, so let's get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"My body's finally warmed up nicely. It'd 
be a waste to stop here!"
choice_data_list: No. You're resting today.
No. You're taking today off.
If you say so...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"My body's finally warmed up nicely. It'd 
be a waste to stop here!"
choice_data_list: ダメ。今日は休んでもらう
ダメ。今日は休んでもらうよ
そこまで言うのなら……
choice_data_list_en: No. You're going to rest today.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Why are you stopping me, Trainer?! I'm 
totally fine with this much!
choice_data_list: ダメ。今日は休んでもらう
ダメ。今日は休んでもらうよ
そこまで言うのなら……
choice_data_list_en: No. You're going to rest today.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Worsen... it could worsen, huh...
choice_data_list: ケガの悪化を考慮して、だ
ケガの悪化を考慮して、だよ
choice_data_list_en: It's to prevent your injury from getting worse.
It's to prevent your injury from getting worse, you know.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
True, not being able to run because of 
that might be boring.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's rest! Even the 'voice of 
destiny' is telling me that's the right 
move!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then we've gotta decide how to spend our 
break right away! A café, shopping—well, 
once we head outside, we'll know where to 
go!
choice_data_list: Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up double-checking what rest truly 
entailed.
choice_data_list: ちょっと待った！

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected, Trainer! You really get 
me!
choice_data_list: But I'll stop if it gets dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that works! Though you definitely 
won't need to worry!"
choice_data_list: でも、危なくなったら止めるから
choice_data_list_en: Still, I'll stop you if it gets dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu*...
choice_data_list:
...How does it feel running at an easy 
pace?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This won't do at all! You should get 
some rest!
choice_data_list: ……軽く流してみて、どう？

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No. But I realized going any further 
wouldn't be good. I wouldn't have known if 
I hadn't run, so I'm glad I tried it!
choice_data_list: い、痛むのか！？
い、痛むの！？

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To prevent the injury from worsening any 
further, we decided to have her rest for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! We can do it, we're gonna make 
it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... phew...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
How's that, Trainer? Even running at full 
power, it doesn't hurt at all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The 'Voice of Destiny' was right after 
all!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, but just to be safe, let's take it 
easy from here on out.

Yeah, but just to be safe, let's take it 
easy after this.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You worry too much, Trainer. Well, I feel 
refreshed after running with all my might, 
so that's fine by me!
choice_data_list: ああ、でも念のため後は軽めにしよう
うん、でも念のため後は軽めにしよう
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, but let's keep the rest light just in case.
Yeah, but let's take it easy for the rest just in case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Epiphaneia continued training 
without pushing herself too hard.
